d: Bihar men 21 navanbar ko mausam ka mijaj badalne vala hai. bhartiy mausam vigyan vibhag, patna ki or se jari purvanuman ke mutabik, rajy ke kaee hisson men barish hone ki sanbhavna hai. khaskar uttar-purvi bihar, dakshin-madhy bihar aur dakshin-purvi bihar ke kuchh ilakon men barish ko lekar alart jari kiya gaya hai. vahin, banka, bhagalpur aur jamuee jile men ek-do sthanon par bhari barish hone ki sanbhavna jataee gaee hai. iske alava dakshin-madhy aur dakshin-purvi bihar ke ek-do sthanon par garaj-chamak ke sath 30 se 40 kilomitar prati ghante ki raphtar se tej hava chal sakti hai.…
